page.layout: One block of text, single column, full width. Page number at head left (376). Running head "RELIQUIÆ" at head centre. No margin notes, no catchword.

main_text.p: In turri argentea, quæ est in arcu majore, reliquiæ iftæ funt pofitæ:

p.i: De capite Iohannis Baptiftæ de Geftimentis Iohannis Evangeliftæ, Andreæ Apoftoli, Sebaftiani, quadraginta martyrum: de Gelo S. Agatha, de Geftimentis S. Sufannæ.

main_text.p: In apfida S. Johannis, in corona Salvatoris,

p.i: Lignum Domini, de lapide S. fepulchri.

main_text.p: In fingularum columnarum ipfius Eccle- fiæ capitellis inclufæ,

p.i: Reliquiæ Sanctorum Philippi & Iacobi, Iohannis & Pauli, Nicandri & Martiani, Cornelii & Cypriani, Cryni, Maximi, Sebaftiani, Phocæ, Eutychii, quadraginta martyrum: de capillis S. Remigii Episcopi.
De lapide S. Sepulchri: de Geftimentis S. Mariæ, de lapide fepulchri ejus, fanctorum apoftolorum Iacobi, Philippi, Bartholomæi: Martini Episcopi.
Lignum Domini, de capite S. Baptiftæ: Bartholomæi Apoftoli, Cyriaci Diaconi.

main_text.p: In frontispicio Ecclesiæ, in cruce ænea.

p.i: Lignum Domini, de lapide S. Sepulchri, Mauri abbatis, & Sanctorum martyrum Iohannis & Pauli.

main_text.p: In agro Caffinenfi, ad S. Stephani, an. 1103. Nonis Novemb.

p.i: De fasciis, quib. infans involutus fuerat, pars lapidis de offio sepulchri dominici, Palma quam manib. tenuit. Hierofolymam ingreffus: de corporib. Matthæi, Matthiæ, Bartholomæi, Stephani protomartyris, Laurentii, Vincentii, Sebaftiani, Cyriaci, duodecim fratrum, Cosmæ & Damiani, Lucia & Geminiani, Mariæ & Marthæ, Tiburtii & Valeriani, Georgii, Hippolytii, Martini Turonensis.

page.notes: Several lines are blurred at the right edge and the foot of the page; some words in the bottom lines (e.g. "Turonensis", "menfis") are partly illegible and transcribed as best read. Marked-up Greek letters and dense abbreviations were read as printed; the ornamental initials are not transcribed. No catchword or signature visible.
